label: INFINITE_1 is maximally knowable, from maximal act and knowability insofar as in act (inference)
rule: Transitivity of the preorder: every degree is at most the act of g, which is at most its knowability
meaning: Let g be INFINITE_1 and b any degree. By the first premise b is at most g's degree of act; by the second, g's degree of act is at most its knowability. Hence b is at most g's knowability, which is therefore maximal. Conditional consequence; both premises stay open.
